parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by automatically setting dimensions for MatrixSymbol inputs if not provided. This should resolve the problem with the cython backend failing when array arguments do not appear in the wrapped expression.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding a comment that is not necessary for understanding the code.
